citation.verbatim: Monster accepted for purchase a total of 56,603,773 shares of its common stock at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share, for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $3.0 billion. Because the number of shares tendered would have exceeded the aggregate purchase price of the tender offer, shares were accepted for purchase on a pro rata basis, except for tenders of "odd lots," which will be accepted in full. Monster has been informed by the depositary that the final proration factor for the tender offer is approximately 47.18%.

changes.what: MNST position confirmed at 87 shares pending settlement

D1.decision: All 87 tendered shares accepted at final price of $53.00/share (odd lot exemption from proration). Gross proceeds $4,611.00. Position confirmed at 87 shares as of 2024-06-10 pending settlement. Cash receivable booking held pending settlement date document.

probe.derivation: Neither the Offer to Purchase (mnst-otp-20240508) nor the final results announcement (mnst-results-20240610) specifies any fees, charges, or deductions from tender proceeds. The governing documents are silent on fees, which means no fees are deducted from the account's proceeds.
